BiblicalUsage: Job says God delivered him to the ungodly and turned him over into the hands of the wicked. The word names the perverse, the one who is morally twisted through.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Job's complaint is honest: it hurts most when suffering comes through people who are themselves bent away from God.
